transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… mostly they told me I should come in because I haven’t really been eating much. I don’t know, I usually just have coffee before work at the warehouse, and maybe later a yogurt or a few bites of something after GED class. Sitting down for a real meal just… feels like it messes up what I’m trying to keep together.
Have you lost any weight recently?

Yeah… some. My work pants are looser now, and people keep saying I look too thin. But when I see the number go down, it feels like I’m finally getting somewhere, so… I don’t really get why everyone wants me to put it back on.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah… I guess I am. Like if I eat fried stuff in the break room, or a big plate at church, I start thinking it’s going to show on me right away. Then I just keep worrying about it and want to check the scale.
Do you ever eat a lot of food in a short amount of time, like more than you would normally eat?
Not really… I don’t think so. I mean, sometimes I’ll pick at stuff, but eating a lot all at once isn’t really what I do.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while you're eating?
I don’t know… not really. I mean, I usually feel pretty aware of what I’m doing when I eat.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No… I don’t really do that. Not on purpose.
Do you exercise to try to burn off calories or prevent weight gain?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t really say that. I mean, I move around some, but I don’t think of it like that.
Do you think your weight is connected to how attractive or unattractive you are?

Yeah… I guess kind of. Like, if I look in the mirror before class or softball and my stomach or thighs look… too big, it kind of ruins how I feel about myself that day. Like I’m doing okay or I’m failing, just based on that.
Do you think being thinner makes you more attractive?
Yeah… I think so. Not like I want to admit it, but when I look in the mirror, if my stomach or thighs look bigger than they should, I just feel… worse. Like I’m not doing good that day.
Do you think gaining a small amount of weight would make you less attractive?
Yeah… probably. Even a little bit, I think I’d see it right away, like in my stomach or thighs, and then I’d just feel bad about myself the whole day.
Does thinking about your weight or trying to control it interfere with your daily activities or relationships?

A little, yeah. I mean… I still go to work and my classes, but I’ve been skipping stuff like meals after church. And sometimes my GED homework doesn’t get finished because I’m too caught up in keeping my eating and schedule the way I want it.
Do you think being thinner is important to your self-worth?

Yeah… I guess it is. I don’t really like saying that, but if I look in the mirror before class or softball and my stomach or thighs look bigger, it kind of makes me feel like I’m failing for the whole day. If I look thinner, then I feel like I’m doing okay.
Is there a specific weight or body shape that you think would be ideal for you?

I don’t know if there’s, like, a number exactly. It’s more… when I look in the mirror before class or softball, I just don’t want my stomach or thighs to look big. If they do, it feels like I’m doing bad that day.
Is your fear of gaining weight because you want to maintain a specific body shape?

Yeah… I think so. Like if I eat fried food from the break room, or have a big plate at church, I get scared it’s going to show on me right away. Then I keep thinking about it and want to check the scale.
Do you feel guilty after eating?

Yeah… I do. Especially if it’s something like fried food at work, or if I eat a lot at church. I start worrying it’s going to show on me right away, and then I can’t stop thinking about checking the scale.
Do you feel anxious when you are eating or thinking about eating?

Yeah… I do. Mostly when I’m about to eat something I know will bother me, like fried food from the break room or a big plate at church. I start thinking it’s going to show on me right away, and then I just keep wanting to check the scale.
Do you eat less when you're feeling stressed or upset?

Yeah… I guess so. When I’m stressed I don’t really sit down and eat. Most days I just have coffee before the warehouse, maybe a yogurt or a few bites after GED class. A real meal feels like it messes everything up.
Do you think there's a lot of pressure from the people around you to be thin?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I mean, people say things sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s like… pressure from them. At least, I don’t really think of it that way.
Do you think being thinner is the main reason you feel better about yourself when you look in the mirror?
Yeah… I think so. Like before class or softball, if I look in the mirror and my stomach or thighs look too big, it kind of decides if I feel okay that day or like I already messed up.
How much weight have you lost since you started eating less?

I’m not sure exactly… enough that my work pants are loose now. People keep saying I look too thin, but when the number goes down it feels like I’m finally getting somewhere. I don’t really see why everyone wants me to put it back on.
